title: Privacy Policy
description: How the official website of Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo collects, uses and protects your information.
body:
**Last updated: 12 November 2026**

This Privacy Policy explains how the official website of Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo ("we", "us") handles information when you visit it. We are committed to protecting your privacy in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

## Information we collect

**Information you send us.** If you email us through the contact links on this website, we receive your email address and anything you choose to include in your message. We use this only to respond to you.

**Usage information.** If you accept analytics cookies, we use Google Analytics and the Meta Pixel to understand how visitors use the website, such as which pages are visited, the type of device and browser used, and the approximate location (city or country). This information does not tell us who you are.

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information.

## Cookies

The website itself works without cookies. Analytics and advertising cookies are only set if you choose **Accept** on the cookie notice. If you choose **Decline**, no tracking cookies are set. You can change your choice at any time using the **Cookie settings** link at the bottom of every page.

## Third party services

- **Google Analytics** (Google LLC) helps us measure website traffic.
- **Meta Pixel** (Meta Platforms, Inc.) helps us measure the reach of our posts and campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
- **Woman to Woman Network 21** registration happens on a separate website, which has its own privacy policy.

These services process data according to their own privacy policies.

## How long we keep information

Emails are kept only as long as needed to respond and follow up. Analytics data is kept according to the default settings of the services above.

## Your rights

You may ask us to tell you what personal information we hold about you, correct it, or delete it, and you may withdraw your consent at any time. To do this, email us at the address below.

## Children

This website is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.

## Contact

For any privacy question or request, email **message@patienceishakuabbo.com**.
